title: No builder makes devbin's public snapshot from tests/shipped.paths: one commit per release on the public branch, the first parentless (ST0010)
body:
ST0010 publishes devbin as a new public repository, from one audited commit of the product (decision 52). hv approved its plan on 2026-10-27 (vc decision 78). Each release publishes one snapshot, made by the same builder (Q7). tests/shipped.paths is the one list of what ships, and the workroom scan reads it. Its header says a snapshot builder reads the same list, but no builder exists. The audit, every later publication and the publish flow need one, so that what is scanned and what ships come from one list.

## Measured

On main at 4ccfde65:
- tests/unit/workroom.bats is the only reader of tests/shipped.paths.
- The list includes paths and leaves fleet's command, roots file, help page and tests out with `:(exclude)` lines.
- No command or script builds a commit from it.

ST0010's earlier candidates were built by hand in vc's scratch. One of them was rebuilt in place, which most likely lost a seal pair that records cite.

## Design

cc's design, approved by vc on 2026-10-27 with R1, is ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-cc/publish/design-0239-0240.md (sha256 43bad350). vc's review is ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/reviews/design-0239-0240.review.md (sha256 570141bf).

- **The verb.** `release snapshot <vX.Y.Z> <new-dir> [--no-parent]`, and `--commit <rev>` for an audit ahead of a cut. It sits in release.verbs.
- **Its keys,** under release.snapshot:
  - `list`: devbin's is tests/shipped.paths, and it has no default;
  - `author`: no default; devbin's is `Matthew Sinclair <hello@matthewsinclair.com>` (decision 81);
  - `message`: default `{name} {version}`.
- **Plumbing throughout,** never `git archive`: read-tree into a temporary index, ls-files over the list, pack-objects of the selected blobs, write-tree, commit-tree.
- **The parent** is the public publish branch's tip, fetched from publish.url, when there is one. It has none under `--no-parent`, or when there is no tip. A second parentless commit would never fast-forward the first.
- **Never on a history that is not snapshots.** Every commit behind the tip must be authored and committed by snapshot.author, and hold no path outside the list its own tree carries (the given list when it carries none). With snapshot.author hv's ordinary identity (decision 81), the path test is the one that tells a workroom commit, which carries intent/ outside its own list, from a snapshot. Checking each commit against its own list keeps an older snapshot passing after a path leaves the current list (cc's refinement, approved by vc on 2026-10-27).
  - **The history reaches its root.** Once grafts and a shallow file are cleared from git's environment and a shallow source is refused, git guarantees that a fetched history reaches its parentless root. So the builder refuses a history cut short rather than checking for a root (cc's finding in its rework, accepted by vc on 2026-10-27).
  - **The workroom is never fetched as the public parent.** The path test cannot tell a workroom commit from a snapshot in a project whose list ships every tracked path. So before fetching a parent, the builder refuses a publish.url whose OWNER/NAME, on any host, matches a workroom remote, and names the remote and `--no-parent`. One function answers that, and 0240's pre-flight asks it too (cc's question, vc's ruling of 2026-10-27).
  - Until the recreate, devbin's publish.url and its origin both name matthewsinclair/devbin, so an audit snapshot made then is built with `--no-parent`.
- **Deterministic.** The identity comes from snapshot.author, the dates from the source commit's committer date in UTC, and the commit is never signed. The same inputs therefore give the same sha, and hv approves a snapshot by its sha.

## Done when

1. From a release tag, and with `--commit` from any commit, the builder makes a commit whose tree equals the source commit's tree filtered by the list in paths, modes and blobs. The builder reads it back, and an arm compares it.
2. Its parent is the publish branch's tip when there is one, and none under `--no-parent` or when there is no tip. A tip is refused, naming the commit and its author, when its history holds a commit not made by snapshot.author or a commit holding a path outside the list its own tree carries. A history cut short (a shallow public repository) is refused, naming the tip. A workroom commit under hv's identity is refused for the paths it carries. An older snapshot made under a longer list still passes after a path leaves the current list. A publish.url whose OWNER/NAME matches a workroom remote, on another host spelling, is refused before any fetch, naming the remote, while the same build with `--no-parent` goes ahead. Each refusal writes nothing. An arm holds each.
3. Built twice from the same inputs, it gives the same sha. It is unsigned, and its author, committer and message carry no workroom identity. Arms hold both.
4. It refuses each of these, naming why and writing nothing: an existing directory, a rev that is not a commit, an undeclared or unreadable list, an include line that matches no file, and a gitlink. A path the list excludes is absent, and the new repository holds no workroom object beyond the shipped blobs.
5. Its help page and the config reference document it. The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU with the tree scans and help, and CI is green on the pushed head.

## Resolution

Fixed at fb66b47979ed46f412e4b738fc62dcf747d87adc, landed on main by vc with the rest of C (fb66b479..7565e2a2) on hv's GO of 29 Oct, as cc banked it. `release snapshot <vX.Y.Z> <new-dir> [--no-parent]`, and `release snapshot --commit <rev> <new-dir>` for an audit ahead of a cut, make the public snapshot: one commit, in a new repository outside the project, whose tree is the source commit's tracked files over release.snapshot.list. The verb is a thin coordinator over `snapshot_build` (lib/cmd/release), which reads every input itself and sets its answer in `SNAPSHOT_*`, so the publish flow (0240) makes the same commit from the same commit by calling it.

- **The keys,** under release: `snapshot.list` (no default; devbin's is tests/shipped.paths), `snapshot.author` (no default; devbin's is hv's identity, decision 81), `snapshot.message` (default `{name} {version}`), `publish.url` and `publish.branch` (default release.branch), each with its value check and pair rule, and `snapshot` among release.verbs. One parser, `cfg_ident` (lib/config), reads an identity for the value check and for the build, and refuses one git would write otherwise (a space, `,`, `:`, `;`, a quote or `\` at either end, more than one space before the `<`), so a snapshot carries the identity as declared.
- **Plumbing throughout:** the commit's tree read into an index of its own, ls-files over the list, exactly the selected blobs packed into the new repository, then write-tree and commit-tree; the commit is read back against the selection, its parent and its identity. The list is read from the source commit's own tree, so `--commit` reads that commit's list, never the checkout's.
- **Deterministic:** author and committer both snapshot.author, both dates the source's committer date at +0000, the message filled as data (quoted replacements, so bash 5.2's patsub_replacement cannot turn an `&` into the match), no encoding header, never signed.
- **The parent.** Before anything is fetched, `release_remote_naming` (lib/release.steps) refuses a publish.url naming, by OWNER/NAME on any host and in any case, the repository one of the project's own remotes names, and says a first snapshot is made with `--no-parent`; 0240's pre-flight asks the same function. Otherwise the publish branch's tip is fetched with its history into the release core's scratch (open_scratch: one root under TMPDIR, removed by its exit trap) and checked there before the new directory exists: every commit behind the tip made and committed by snapshot.author, with one parent at most, holding no path outside the list its own tree carries. A refusal names the commit and who made and committed it. A shallow source is refused at the fetch, where git writes no ref, so the history the walk reads always reaches its parentless root and the builder carries no root check of its own (vc's ruling on cc's Q2; 0239's text amended at 49278183).
- **Its own git.** Every git call runs with git's repository-local variables cleared (git_local_env_clear), the pathspec variables unset, hooks off and no reflog, so an inherited GIT_DIR, GIT_INDEX_FILE, GIT_SHALLOW_FILE or graft cannot point the build elsewhere or cut its walk short. The new directory is placed as it resolves (cargo_place) and held outside the project by -ef up its ancestors, so a wrong case on APFS, a leading `//` or a `..` after a link cannot put it inside.

Documented in docs/configuration.md, lib/pages/release.md and lib/config.reference.yaml; devbin's own bin/.devbin/config.yaml declares its list and identity. At 0239's own commit a publish.url that is a local path is not compared with the project's remotes, a residual vc accepted; 0240, the bank's next commit, compares one by what it resolves to (`-ef`). 0261, later in the bank, moves the list's reading into lib/helpers (`pathlist_specs`, `pathspec_excludes`), and the builder reads through it.

- **Done when 1.** releasesnapshot.bats's arm "release snapshot makes one commit whose tree is the tag's tracked files over the list, in paths, modes and blobs (0239)" builds from an annotated tag, as a cut makes one, and compares the snapshot's tree, entry by entry, with git's own reading of the list over the tag's commit (its tree in an index of its own, ls-files over the list's lines, read through pathlist_specs), in paths, modes and blobs. It also names what the list's lines did: the `:(exclude)` line kept docs/private.md out, intent/notes.md, which the list never names, is absent, a link stays a link and an executable stays executable. "--commit makes the snapshot of any commit from that commit alone, never the index or the working tree (0239)" builds from a commit whose checkout differs from it three ways (a file staged otherwise, the list changed and not staged, an untracked file) and gets that commit's files over that commit's list.
- **Done when 2.** An arm each: "the parent is the publish branch's tip, and there is none while the branch is not there or under --no-parent (0239)"; "a publish branch holding a commit release.snapshot.author did not make is refused, naming the commit and who made it (0239)", the workroom's own main, naming the commit, its author and its committer; "a commit under release.snapshot.author's own identity is refused for a path outside the list its tree carries, naming the commit and who made it (0239)", for docs/private.md; "an older snapshot made under a longer list still passes after a path leaves the list (0239)"; "a publish branch whose history holds a merge is refused, naming it and who made it: a snapshot has one parent at most (0239)"; "a publish.url naming the repository one of the project's remotes names, on another host's spelling, is refused before anything is fetched, naming the remote, and --no-parent builds (0239)", where the fixture's origin (`https://github.com/t/demo.git`) is named through an ssh host alias and in another case (`git@gh-alias:T/Demo.git`), where nothing answers, refused naming origin and `--no-parent`, with the project's fingerprint unchanged, and the same build with `--no-parent` goes ahead; and "a publish branch whose history is cut short, as a shallow repository's is, ending in no parentless root, is refused, and nothing is written (0239)", naming the tip. Each refusal arm checks that the new directory was not made and that the run's TMPDIR, the test's own, was left empty.
- **Done when 3.** "the same inputs give the same commit, under release.snapshot.author at the source's committer date in UTC, with the template's message, unsigned (0239)" builds twice, the first time under a global config that sets i18n.commitEncoding, and gets one sha. The commit carries no gpgsig and no encoding header; its author and committer are snapshot.author at the source's committer date at +0000, from a fixture commit at +0530 whose author date differs from its committer date; its message is `demo 1.0.0`; and the workroom's identity, t <t@t>, is nowhere in it. "the message is filled as data: a project name holding & is written as it is (0239)" names the project `R&D` and gets `R&D 1.0.0`.
- **Done when 4.** "every refusal of the source or the directory names why and writes nothing (0239)" is one table arm: an existing directory, a rev that is no commit (an unknown rev, `HEAD^{tree}`, `v1.0.0:VERSION`), a tag that is not there, a directory inside the project (directly, with a leading `//`, and through `..` after a link leading back into it) and a directory whose parent does not exist, each naming why; the existing directory stays empty, nothing else is made, and the project's fingerprint (its files, refs, config and remote) is unchanged. Arms of their own refuse, each writing nothing: "a list that is not declared is refused, naming the key, and nothing is written (0239)", "a list the commit does not hold is refused, naming it, and nothing is written (0239)", "a line of the list that matches no file is refused, naming the line, and nothing is written (0239)", "a gitlink in what the list selects is refused, naming it, and nothing is written (0239)" and "a branch git would not take is refused before anything is made (0239)". Done when 1's arm holds the excluded path absent, and "the new repository holds no object but the snapshot's own (0239)" holds the new repository to exactly the objects the snapshot reaches, the workroom's commit not among them. "the snapshot's keys are validated, each refusal naming the key (0239)" and "release snapshot's arguments are read before anything acts, and usage names the verb (0239)" hold the keys' checks and the verb's arguments.
- **Done when 5.** The release page, the reference config and docs/configuration.md document the verb and its keys, and releasecore.bats reads the new verb and keys. The landing suite: C's arms phase, in estate slot 01M61TNPWJTZMYNDBPTEZZ54ZG on molt-vc's grant, ran every arm tagged with one of the bank's eight issues on main 09c7d61a, file by file, from 2026-10-28 18:00Z to 18:08Z: in the red clone f4b30a50, main's lib with the bank's tests, under BSD; then at the bank's tip 53c92332 under BSD, and again with GNU coreutils, findutils, sed and grep first on PATH (~/Devel/scratch/devbin-cc/s5e/runs/arms/, summary in s5e/arms.out). Each of 0239's 20 arms failed in the red clone and passed under BSD and GNU. C was stopped on hv's word in its light phase, so its whole-file legs, the tree scans among them, did not finish; hv's runs on main took them over. hv's first test all on main (tmp/test/20261029-0614) found two breaches in 0239's code, which caf77878 fixed: contract.bats 338, where snapshot_build's git_local_env_clear failure exited 2, the dispatcher's code, and now exits 3, caught by its caller; and contract.bats 348, where _snapshot_git's export inside its subshell now carries SC2031's disable with its reason. hv's `dvb test all` on rhadamanth at 217adf65 ran every one of the 2777 tests bats counts in tests/unit once, and none failed (tmp/test/20261029-0817.bats.out, its .errors empty). K0116B, the full suite on kovacs at 4d1a76b0 with rustup's cargo first on PATH, as on CI's Ubuntu runner, is green, as vc read its seal. CI run 40851772728 on 4d1a76b0 and CI run 40860048152 on 25175386, the head 0.1.16 was cut from, are green on Test on Ubuntu, Shell Script Analysis and Test Summary. No critic leg ran on the landed commits.

- **CI:** run 40860048152 on the pushed head 25175386, which carries the landing, read green by vc.
